critical_code_review_comments: documents.py from-text: AI generation is slow (30-40s) and blocks. Consider background job + progress polling if this is user-facing.

estimation_routes.py _attach_pool_items conditionally adds pool_items only for pool project types — good. Consumers should defensively check `if 'pool_items' in est` (currently PoolItemsCard renders when pool truthy, fine).

profitability.py: job doc_id 404 works via _quote; PATCH /finish reuses list_costs response — clean. But `report` endpoint filters by user_id + status/signed — if a quote is unsigned but has costs, it's excluded from report which may hide dev-time costs. Consider surfacing untracked costs.
PoolItemsCard.jsx: createQuote POSTs and navigates — no local error UI on failure, only console. Consider toast on error.

Estimator.jsx step==2 shows results but reopening /estimation preserves state — a fresh visit auto-restores previous type which caused a subtle mismatch when trying to change type without going through 'Modifier les paramètres'. Not a bug but a UX subtlety.
QuoteEditor.jsx L279: on preference change we PUT and toast success — no reload of surrounding data (existing lines keep their prices). Acceptable but users might expect a re-price refresh.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted quotes: doc_060da3483132 (pool test quote from pool-create-quote-btn UI flow) — DELETED via API. Created & deleted UI test cost 'TEST_iter129 UI cost' on doc_90999ae3eea1 (cost_9476a444b5) — DELETED via API. Backend pytest also created transient TEST_iter129 rentabilité quote and TEST_Achat test cost, both cleaned up in fixture teardown. Preference reset to shared_first at end. doc_90999ae3eea1 left with finished=true (as main agent had set).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Estimator: when navigating to /estimation, previously computed state auto-loads showing results view — must click data-testid='edit-estimation-btn' or use URL param ?type=<key> to jump straight to correct type at step 0. Radix Select options open via .click() on trigger; options appear as [role=option] and require .click(force=True) to bypass overlay. Profitability delete-cost may open a confirm dialog — my UI test clicked delete then finish quickly and hit an 'element not attached' DOM detachment; not a bug, timing only. The pool_items are only in response for pool project types (piscine_*); other types have NO pool_items key.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features working as spec'd.
